collections.name: Swamp Monster
collections.hint: Swamp monster heard screaming and killing a deer then running off into the forest with green smoke coming off it

collections.name: Bigfoot
collections.hint: You can hear roars and chase him through the marshes and I came across a wicker man and passed out. Came too in the marshes

collections.name: Redneck Shooting Party
collections.hint: Two possibly intoxicated rednecks practising their aim in the middle of nowhere aaaaand.. you can join

collections.name: Plane crash
collections.hint: Plane crashed with a shipment of drugs > Collect it > Kill the NPCs > Watch out, cops are coming > Sell the drugs at Bayn’s warehouse

collections.name: Tree man
collections.hint: A humanoid-shaped tree surrounded by flowers that release spores; if you stay nearby for too long, a cutscene featuring a creature will be triggered.

collections.name: X-Files Close Encounter
collections.hint: An abandoned car sits on the roadside, all doors wide open, emitting strange electronic noises. A trail of discarded clothes leads into the nearby woods. Follow it deeper into the forest to uncover a... weird encounter.

collections.name: Drunkard Asking for Money
collections.hint: Drunkark going around asking for money

sources.label: GTABase map — Drunkard Asking for Money

collections.name: Plane Crash: Cocaine and Map
collections.hint: This is a crashed plane with a map to deliver the cocaine. 2 bundles of cocaine are located next to the plane

sources.label: GTABase map — Plane Crash: Cocaine and Map

collections.name: Wheelchair Robbery
collections.hint: Community marker on the GTABase map; no description was published with it.

collections.name: Hijack a Robbery
collections.hint: A Mother and Daughter will be robbing the liquor store late at night; you can take their filled van off them and get about $1.5K from the back of the van. Van also has extra storage spots

collections.name: Cocaine Yacht
collections.hint: If you follow the map from the plane crash in Pellican Valley, you'll find the yacht where the plane was supposed to deliver cocaine. On board, some cash and cocaine to grab

collections.name: Traffic Stop: Drunk Steals Cop Car
collections.hint: A drunk guy is stopped by two cops and taunts them before hopping in a squad car to take it for a joy ride.

sources.label: GTABase map — Traffic Stop: Drunk Steals Cop Car

collections.name: Gas Redneck
collections.hint: A redneck ranting about the deep state is filling up a bathtub in a pickup truck bed with gasoline. He will spray it at the player if they get too close and will usually drive off and explode as he crashes somehow

collections.name: Smuggler Boat Explosion
collections.hint: Cocaine Smuggler Boat explodes around here. Easy $1.2k in drugs. Watch out for the sharks. Marker may need some adjusting but it’s roughly correct

collections.name: UFO Event: Suspicious Car
collections.hint: Find a car acting suspiciously, inspect the scene.

sources.label: GTABase map — UFO Event: Suspicious Car

collections.name: Skunk Apeology 101
collections.hint: Speak to the stranger flying the drones.

collections.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
collections.hint: Help push the van out of the mud.

sources.label: GTABase map — Van Stuck in the Mud

collections.name: Missing Wife
collections.hint: Help Alan Coleman find his wife after a car accident.

collections.name: Cocaine Yacht Shark Attack
collections.hint: As you boat through here you hear an explosion: a small boat is on fire after a shark attack. About 4 bags of cocaine float around it.

sources.label: GTABase map — Cocaine Yacht Shark Attack

collections.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
collections.hint: Two men are stuck with their van in the mud: help push it out for $200. Open the van: a tiger jumps out, kills one of the men, then attacks you.

sources.label: GTABase map — Van Stuck in the Mud

collections.name: Witch of the Swamp
collections.hint: A woman called the Witch of the Swamp talks about the swamp and asks you to come back a few days later.

sources.label: GTABase map — Witch of the Swamp

collections.name: Hunter Shoots His Friend
collections.hint: You hear a gunshot and find two hunters arguing. They ask you to take them to the Hamlet hospital.

sources.label: GTABase map — Hunter Shoots His Friend

collections.name: VR Gamer (house)
collections.hint: There's a gamer inside the house that's using VR to watch adult content. You get sound notification when you pass the house. There's a couple of other things to do here, a Smash 'n' Grab, unique vehicle in the garage and a Basketball hoop.

collections.name: Drug Deal
collections.hint: Multiple Cars and a fanboat parked around a stash bag and some gas cans at night. Flares are scattered around. Multiple weapons available and roughly $1.8k in drugs plus some cash.

collections.name: Kingfishers Ambush on the Road
collections.hint: If you have done the robbery with donnie you might get this event where kingfisher ambush you on the highway while blocking the road and shooting at you

sources.label: GTABase map — Kingfishers Ambush on the Road

collections.name: Investigate the Photos
collections.hint: (Investigation into the missing persons photos around the area.) The photos you found could be connected to the missing persons posters in Port Gellhorn. Workout where they were taken to find out if there's a connection.

collections.name: Yard Sale (Arthur Morgan hat)
collections.hint: There's a yard sale here with an Arthur Morgan hat

sources.label: GTABase map — Yard Sale (Arthur Morgan hat)

collections.name: Alien Witness
collections.hint: He says that he saw an alien in this location

collections.name: Hollow Earther's Camp
collections.hint: Community marker on the GTABase map; no description was published with it.

collections.name: Exploding Smuggler Boat
collections.hint: A boat with cocaine explodes and the driver gets eaten by a shark. You can collect 3-4 packages cocaine per $400 each.

collections.name: Garage Band
collections.hint: Two dudes on garage

collections.name: Save the Cow
collections.hint: A well-dressed show cow escapes. Return her to her owner... or don't.

collections.name: Missing Person Poster
collections.hint: A missing person poster from Port Gellhorn, found under the floorboards of the RV with "no lives" spray-painted next to the door. The body of one of the missing tourists is hidden beneath the floor of a trailer in the abandoned trailer park

collections.name: Fortune Teller
collections.hint: A fortune teller offers bad advice for $1, good advice for $5, great advice for $10, a secret for $100 and your future for $1,000.

collections.name: Save the Bear Protest
collections.hint: Protesters block the street to free a bear from the back of a van. Convince the driver to let it out: it is a polar bear, which you can shoot and send to Bret.

sources.label: GTABase map — Save the Bear Protest

collections.name: Cool Dog on a Jet Ski
collections.hint: Jump off a boat in this area and swim for a moment until you hear a dog barking. Turn around to find a dog on a jet ski: hop on and he takes you to a dog island.

sources.label: GTABase map — Cool Dog on a Jet Ski

collections.name: Cigarette Trick
collections.hint: A man shows you a cigarette trick if you give him a cigarette.

collections.name: Escaped Prisoners
collections.hint: Community marker on the GTABase map; no description was published with it.

collections.name: Trailer Girl (yacht)
collections.hint: The woman from the GTA 6 trailer, found on Mattia's yacht.

collections.hint: A truck stuck in the mud.

sources.label: GTABase map — Truck Stuck in the Mud

collections.hint: Find the pink car with the plate PRTYGRL, under another car, and open the trunk to find the body.

collections.name: Bear Encounter
collections.hint: A tourist confronted by a bear asks you what to do.

collections.name: Kitty Drug Bust
collections.hint: Police block the road while they raid a house. Members report a woman making cat litter in the garage, with a cash box ($600+) on the table, and a black box full of cash inside the house (watch out for the police).

collections.name: Caleb, the Drunk Tractor Driver
collections.hint: A drunk tractor driver asks you to drive him to Stacy, his ex-boss.
